evidence.note: idle canvas of the onboarding project
labelled image toolbar + chip in composer

observations.text: The canvas is tldraw (role=application aria-label=tldraw, .tl-shape, TLDRAW_TAB_ID_v2 global). Custom shape types: c-image, c-generator, c-video-generator, text, group. Shape records hold name/url/originalUrl only — no prompt, model or parent-job metadata on the image record (raw/canvas.populated.shapes.json).

Selecting one image: floating toolbar above the selection (7 AI ops + GIF + ··· + download), a name/size label ('Image 221 · 1024 × 1024'), and the selection is mirrored as a chip inside the agent composer (multi-select → one chip per shape). No right inspector exists.
Credit cost is shown in place: Run ⚡14 in quick edit, 矢量 ⚡9 in the ··· menu, ⚡15 on the image generator button, ⚡90 on the video generator. Free tier shows ⚡70 daily credits.
调整 (adjust) is paywalled on the free tier — clicking it opens the plan modal. The download button also opens the paywall after '导出完成'.

Agent chat lives in a persistent right panel, collapsible via |→; a '对话' button in the top bar re-opens it and the canvas widens. Empty state lists Skills. Mode switch Agent / 图像 / 视频 changes the composer's target.

Generator tools are canvas nodes: clicking 图像生成器 inserts a 1024×1024 'Image Generator' placeholder shape (props generatorName openai/gpt-image-2, quality medium, count 1) with its composer beneath. Video node: seedance/seedance-2-0, 5s, 720p, referenceMode multiImage, generateAudio true.

Versioning: app menu → 画布历史 opens a full-screen snapshot browser (保存/打开 tagged snapshots with element count and size, 恢复 to restore). The layers drawer also has a 历史记录 section. No side-by-side compare UI observed.
UI state persists across reload: camera zoom, selection, quick-edit mode, open popovers (brand-kit, font generator), collapsed agent panel all came back after a hard reload.
Right-click menu includes 发送至对话 (send to chat) and 合并图层 (merge layers) alongside standard tldraw ops; 自动整理 ⇧A auto-arranges.

Professional tools are modal tools in the bottom dock (select V / hand H, 标记 C, 智能画板 F, shapes R/L/⇧L/O, pen P, text T) plus the layers drawer; text editing exposes font family/style/fill/stroke in a floating bar.
The tool bar collapses labels to icons responsively (labelled at 640px canvas when zoomed out, icon-only when the toolbar would overflow).
画布历史 is browser-local (testid local-history-close-button, snapshots tagged by session events 打开/保存), not a server version list.
自定义工具栏 submenu contents; 导出 submenu formats; 标记 tool behaviour; share dialog contents (blocked by stacked popovers); Mockup / 扩展 / 多角度 / 图层拆分 panels (each would spend credits).
